title: neutral work lighting and early LED indicators

specimens.name: Sealed twin-tube fluorescent ceiling fixture
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Rectangular late-1990s industrial/laboratory fixture with two fluorescent tube forms behind one prismatic sealed diffuser and clean gray housing; switched off, no glow or projected light.

specimens.name: Slim under-cabinet fluorescent task fixture
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. Narrow beige/gray linear fluorescent task-light housing with frosted diffuser and compact mounting tabs; switched off, no glow, no surrounding cabinet.

specimens.name: Articulated halogen machine task lamp
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. Compact dark/gray halogen task-lamp head connected to the pivot base by EXACTLY ONE short rigid articulated arm segment and one head pivot; no second link, no scissor/parallel arm and no multi-joint chain. Sealed clear lens; lamp off, no light pool, wiring or machine.

specimens.name: Sealed rectangular inspection/work lamp
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. Compact rectangular metal/polymer work-light housing with clear ribbed lens, gasketed perimeter and adjustable short bracket; switched off, no glow.

specimens.name: Small red LED panel indicator
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Very small shallow low-profile red LED lens/package in a compact standardized late-1990s panel bezel; the bezel/body must be visibly much smaller and shallower than the top-row lamp fixtures and must not resemble a deep square incandescent lamp housing; unlit, no label or surrounding panel.

specimens.name: Small amber LED panel indicator
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. Matching very small shallow low-profile amber LED lens/package and compact bezel from the same family as specimen 05; visibly much smaller and shallower than the top-row fixtures, not a deep square lamp housing; unlit.

specimens.name: Small green LED panel indicator
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. Matching very small shallow low-profile green LED lens/package and compact bezel from the same family as specimens 05–06; visibly much smaller and shallower than the top-row fixtures, not a deep square lamp housing; unlit.

specimens.name: Six-LED functional status-strip module
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. One narrow standardized housing with six small unlit physical LED lenses arranged in two separated functional groups of three, using red/amber/green lens colors; lenses and bezel depth should match the compact late-1990s LED-package language of specimens 05–07; no text, legends or active glow.

global_forbidden: text, letters, numbers, logos or pseudo-writing
bare bulbs, improvised clamp lamps, large E1-style incandescent panel indicators, rotating beacons or signal towers
multi-link articulated task-lamp arms, scissor/parallel lamp arms or more than one arm segment for specimen 03
deep square lamp-style indicator housings, bulky incandescent-style indicator bodies or oversized E1-style panel indicators for specimens 05–07
complete lighting installations, wiring, control panels, machines, buildings, rooms or scenes
any ninth or extra specimen, duplicate specimen, omitted specimen, merged specimen or substitution
active light, lit tubes, glowing LEDs, bloom, rays, projected light pools or baked cast/contact shadows
decorative LED strips, neon, modern architectural light bars or E3/E4 lighting language
photorealistic fixture catalog rendering, filtered 3D render or soft studio photography

era_contract.character: late-1990s test-center lighting with neutral fluorescent work fixtures, compact sealed task lamps and distinctly smaller shallow early-LED status indication
required_signals: exactly one short articulated arm segment on the halogen task lamp
small shallow low-profile standardized LED indicator packages visibly reduced from E1 lamp-sized indicators
replaced_previous_language: E1 bulkier enclosed fluorescent/bulkhead/pendant fixture family as the dominant vocabulary
larger round red/amber/green panel indicators with deeper lamp-style bodies
three-lamp status housings based on larger lens hardware
forbidden_regressions: modern thin LED area lights or architectural lighting
